title: Juicy Yields Draw Junk Bond Buyers to Investment-Grade AI Debt
summary: Companies financing AI data center projects are increasingly turning to junk bond investors to raise billions of dollars, even for debt that is technically investment-grade. The trend shows high-yield investors chasing exposure to the AI infrastructure buildout despite the debt's higher credit rating.

title: ¿Cómo usan la IA las organizaciones criminales? Esto dice un estudio
summary: Un estudio del investigador Juan Manuel Aguilar-Antonio (UNAM), presentado con apoyo del programa EL PAcCTO 2.0 de la Unión Europea, documenta cómo el Cártel Jalisco Nueva Generación y el Cártel de Sinaloa han comenzado a incorporar inteligencia artificial y herramientas digitales para reforzar logística, extorsión, vigilancia y reclutamiento. La investigación clasifica a las organizaciones criminales de América Latina según su nivel de sofisticación tecnológica.

title: Nvidia Customers Notified About AI-Related Price Hikes Above 15%
summary: Some of Nvidia's biggest customers have been told that prices for servers containing its AI chips are rising more than 15% in many cases, driven by soaring memory chip costs. The hikes add to concerns about the rising cost of building out AI infrastructure.

title: Study Shows AI Hitting Paychecks, Not Payrolls
summary: Apollo chief economist Torsten Slok says early labor-market data suggest AI's first impact is showing up more in weaker wage growth for AI-exposed jobs than in job losses, though AI is also fueling record business formation. Former IBM HR chief Diane Gherson notes companies are already deciding which work to automate, retrain for, or cut as AI savings materialize.

title: Chinese AI Models Gain Ground on Price and Use
summary: Chinese AI models are rapidly closing the performance gap with US rivals while winning users through lower prices and open-weight technology that lets companies deploy them locally. Bloomberg's Luz Ding notes their capabilities are approaching leading US models at a fraction of the cost.

title: The AI Spending Spree Comes With a Catch
summary: Former IBM CEO Sam Palmisano warns the AI boom rests on long-cycle bets in data centers, chips and energy even as AI software evolves at breakneck speed. If adoption slows or cheaper Chinese open-source models gain traction, Big Tech may need to rethink the massive spending plans behind today's AI race.

title: Apollo’s Slok Says AI Weighs On Pay Without Cutting Jobs — Yet
summary: Apollo Global Management chief economist Torsten Slok found that AI adoption is already weighing on wages in the US labor market without yet triggering significant job cuts, an early and unexpected signal of how AI is reshaping employment.

title: How Germany’s doctors, lawyers and dentists got burnt by private markets bets
summary: German professionals — including doctors, lawyers and dentists — have been burned by their mandatory pension schemes' bets on private markets, raising questions about how these funds, worth roughly €300 billion, are being managed.

title: Estados Unidos trabaja en un nuevo acuerdo comercial con México: Trump
summary: El presidente Donald Trump afirmó que Estados Unidos ya trabaja en un nuevo acuerdo comercial con México, luego de que su gobierno optó por revisiones anuales del T-MEC en vez de extender el tratado vigente. El canciller económico Marcelo Ebrard dijo que espera resultados similares a los alcanzados preliminarmente con Canadá, aunque los detalles aún están por definirse.

title: ITG CFO: We're the Picks & Shovels of the AI Boom
summary: ITG CFO Chris Mecray describes the fiber and communications company as the "picks and shovels" of the AI boom, citing a long runway of opportunity in building the connectivity data centers require. He discussed the company's performance since its July 1 IPO on Bloomberg Businessweek Daily.

title: El peso cierra en 16.92 por dólar, pero la economía no levanta
summary: El peso mexicano cerró la semana en 16.92 unidades por dólar, según Expansión, en un contexto en el que la economía del país no muestra señales claras de repunte. La nota apunta a la disociación entre la fortaleza cambiaria y el desempeño económico general.

title: Anthropic Taps Google Chip Veteran as Part of Push Into Hardware
summary: Anthropic has hired Amir Salek, founder of Alphabet's custom chip program at Google, as the AI lab lays groundwork for a push into designing its own semiconductors. The hire signals Anthropic's ambition to reduce reliance on third-party chipmakers as it scales its AI infrastructure.

title: Khosla Ventures Bets on AI’s Next Frontier: Science
summary: Khosla Ventures is backing Discovery Loop, a new AI startup founded by former Google leaders including Jeff Dean, aimed at dramatically accelerating scientific experimentation. Managing Director Samir Kaul says the opportunity could be as profound as frontier AI models, and that soaring valuations are forcing venture investors to rethink what "seed stage" even means.

title: Wall Street Struggles to Absorb AI’s Debt Boom
summary: Broadcom is reportedly in talks to raise more than $60 billion in debt to help Anthropic and others secure AI chips and computing power, underscoring Wall Street's growing unease about funding the AI buildout. Investors are increasingly concerned about circular financing arrangements and how sustainable the debt-fueled AI trade really is.

title: Anthropic Preps for Blockbuster Public Listing | Bloomberg Tech 8/21/2026
summary: Anthropic is preparing for an IPO that could match or exceed the size of SpaceX's record-setting listing, Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow reports. The segment also notes Broadcom is in talks to raise over $60 billion in debt to help Anthropic and others secure AI chips and computing power, with Nvidia's earnings also in focus next week.

title: Anthropic Aims to Match or Top SpaceX IPO
summary: Anthropic is reportedly aiming for an IPO that could match or top SpaceX's record-setting debut, with the maker of Claude potentially filing publicly by the end of the month. The company raised $65 billion in May at a $965 billion valuation, according to Bloomberg's Shirin Ghaffary and Liana Baker.

title: Casa Pura Vida / Zozaya Arquitectos
summary: Casa Pura Vida is a new residence in Troncones, Mexico, designed by Zozaya Arquitectos to showcase the country's construction craftsmanship and rich local materials. The project was conceived as a contemporary home reflecting the clients' desire for a distinctive property in the coastal region.

title: Yuval Noah Harari on the economic and political perils of AI
summary: Historian Yuval Noah Harari warns that humanity must not entrust its future to "clever machines," cautioning against ceding too much economic and political power to AI systems. The piece frames AI's rise as a risk to human agency and governance as much as an opportunity.
